name: Robben Island
note: The island, its prison and the museum tour from the Nelson Mandela Gateway are one entry.

name: Boulders Beach
note: The African penguin colony is what the beach is visited for.

name: Camps Bay Beach
note: The item is the suburb, which the Wikipedia articles are on; same_as is the beach's own item, with one sitelink.

name: Cape of Good Hope
aliases: Cape of Good Hope Nature Reserve
note: The south-western headland in the Cape Point section of Table Mountain National Park.

name: Cape Winelands
note: The wine district east of the city taken whole; Stellenbosch, Franschhoek, Paarl and the estates have entries of their own.

name: Chapman's Peak Drive
note: The toll road cut into the cliff between Hout Bay and Noordhoek, driven for the views; filed as a viewpoint the way a pass is.

name: African penguin
note: At Boulders Beach and on Robben Island; all year.

name: Cape Floral Region Protected Areas
note: A serial natural property of thirteen protected-area clusters across the Western and Eastern Cape; Table Mountain National Park is the component within the reach, and the item's coordinates sit far east of the city. The id is on the Cape Floristic Kingdom item, which carries the inscription (1007, 1007bis); Table Mountain National Park's item carries component 1007-001.

name: Cape Town City Hall
note: Where Nelson Mandela spoke from the balcony on his release, 11 February 1990.

name: Cape wine
note: The item is South African wine as a whole; the Cape is where all but a sliver of it is grown.

name: Constantia wine valley
note: The oldest wine district, on the back of Table Mountain; its estates Groot Constantia, Klein Constantia, Buitenverwachting and Steenberg have entries of their own. The item is the suburb of Constantia, which the valley is.

name: Boat trip to Duiker Island
note: The seal colony off Hout Bay; the boats leave from the harbour.

name: Lion's Head
note: The peak and its summit trail, climbed at sunrise and at full moon, are one entry.

name: Nelson Mandela
note: Robben Island, the City Hall balcony and the Drakenstein gate are his places here.

name: Southern right whale
note: June to November, False Bay and the Whale Coast.

name: Table Mountain National Park
note: A component of World Heritage property 1007 (Cape Floral Region Protected Areas), which is its own entry.

name: Whale watching
note: Southern right whales from June to November, from the False Bay shore, by boat from Simon's Town, or at Hermanus; many places, so no venue.

name: Wine tasting on a Winelands estate
note: Done at hundreds of estates, so it names no venue.

name: Cape Malay cuisine
note: The search found only curry in general, which is not this.

name: Cape Peninsula round trip
note: The day's drive down the Atlantic side by Chapman's Peak to Cape Point and back by Simon's Town and the False Bay coast.

name: Chacma baboon
note: The troops of the Cape Point section.

name: Dorp Street
note: Stellenbosch's oak-lined street of Cape Dutch and Victorian houses. No Wikidata item found for Stellenbosch's; Q56340287 is Cape Town's Dorp Street in the Bo-Kaap.

name: Groot Constantia
note: same_as is the manor house's own item, with one sitelink.

name: Hermanus
note: About 100 km east of the centre, outside the reach; every guide files the whale-watching capital under a Cape Town day trip in season (June to November), with its cliff path and whale crier.

name: Hoerikwaggo Trail
note: The multi-day trail along the peninsula's mountain chain from Cape Point to Table Mountain. The search returned Q25389004 by name; the item has one sitelink, no English label and no coordinates.

name: Platteklip Gorge trail
note: The direct ascent of Table Mountain from Tafelberg Road.

name: Silvermine Nature Reserve
note: The central section of Table Mountain National Park, above Ou Kaapse Weg.

name: Township tour
note: A resident-led tour of Langa, Gugulethu or Khayelitsha, with a shebeen lunch; done in many townships, so it names no venue.

name: West Coast National Park
note: About 100 km north, outside the reach; a Cape Town day trip for the spring flowers of August and September and the lagoon.

name: Woodstock
note: The former industrial quarter known for its street art, the Old Biscuit Mill and its Saturday market.

name: Zeitz Museum of Contemporary Art Africa
Bay Harbour Market
note: No Wikidata item found.

name: Bontebok
note: In the Cape Point section of the park.

name: Cape fur seal
note: Duiker Island off Hout Bay; the Waterfront's quays.

name: Cape linefish
note: The local line-caught fish on every menu: yellowtail, kingklip, snoek, Cape salmon. No item for the local catch as a whole.

name: Cape Point Lighthouse
note: The old lighthouse of 1859 at the top of the funicular; the working one of 1919 stands lower on the point. The item is the old lighthouse of 1859; the new one is Q10966914.

name: Desmond Tutu
note: St George's Cathedral and Nobel Square.

name: Durbanville Wine Valley
note: The item is the suburb of Durbanville; its Wikidata coordinates (18.85 E) fall near Paarl, plainly not the place's, so lat and lon are left null.

name: Franschhoek Pass
note: The mountain road out of the valley towards Villiersdorp, driven for the view back over Franschhoek.

name: Franschhoek Wine Tram
note: The hop-on hop-off tram and bus between the valley's estates; many estates, so no venue.

name: Just Nuisance statue
note: The bronze of the Great Dane enlisted in the Royal Navy, on Jubilee Square.

name: King protea
note: The national flower and the fynbos it stands for, at Kirstenbosch and on the mountain.

name: Koeksister
note: Both the plaited syrup koeksister and the Cape Malay spiced koesister are named.

name: KWV Wine Emporium
note: The co-operative's cellars at Paarl, with brandy as well as wine. The item is the company; its cellars at Paarl have no item of their own, and the item has no coordinates.

name: Langa
note: Cape Town's oldest township, visited on a resident-led walk.

name: Mariner's Wharf
note: The harbour-front fish market and restaurant at Hout Bay.

name: Nobel Square
note: The four bronzes of South Africa's Nobel Peace laureates at the Waterfront.

name: Paarl Rock
note: The granite domes above the town, in the Paarl Mountain Nature Reserve. The item is Paarlberg, the mountain whose granite domes the rock is; the nature reserve is Q141947504.

name: Pinotage
note: The grape bred at Stellenbosch in 1925.

name: Rock hyrax
note: On the summit of Table Mountain.

name: Sea kayaking
note: From Simon's Town to the penguins at Boulders, or along the Sea Point shore.

name: Sea Point Promenade
note: No Wikidata item found for the promenade.

name: South African Jewish Museum
note: The museum and the Holocaust centre share the Gardens campus beside the Great Synagogue.

name: St James tidal pool and bathing boxes
Steenberg
note: The item is the estate (one sitelink); Q7605878 is the suburb.

name: Stellenbosch Village Museum
note: Four restored houses of 1709 to 1850 on one block. The item is Stellenbosch Museum, the museum's formal name.

name: Tokai Forest
note: The item is Tokai Park, the section of Table Mountain National Park; same_as is a second item for the same section, with no sitelinks.

name: Twelve Apostles
note: The range of buttresses above Camps Bay, named as the beach's backdrop.

name: Vergelegen
note: The 1700 estate at Somerset West, visited for its gardens and camphor trees as much as its wine.

name: World of Birds
aliases: World of Birds Wildlife Sanctuary and Monkey Park

name: Biesmiellah
note: The Cape Malay restaurant in the Bo-Kaap. No Wikidata item found.

name: Bloubergstrand
note: The beach with the classic view of Table Mountain across Table Bay.

name: Bordjiesrif
note: A tidal pool in the Cape Point section of the park.

name: Braai
note: The barbecue as the way a weekend is spent, at the tidal pools of Cape Point as much as at home.

name: Brass Bell
note: The pub and fish restaurant on the rocks at Kalk Bay station. No Wikidata item found.

name: Buffels Bay
note: A tidal pool and braai spot in the Cape Point section of the park. The item is the bay on the Cape Peninsula (Q14213714); Q31884242 of the same name has coordinates near Darling and Q1825081 is the Knysna village.

name: Cape to Cuba
note: The Cuban-themed bar and restaurant in Kalk Bay. No Wikidata item found.

name: Cape Town Fashion Week
note: No Wikidata item found.

name: Cape Town Minstrel Carnival
note: The minstrel troupes' parade through the Bo-Kaap and the city on 2 January.

name: Castle Military Museum
note: Inside the Castle of Good Hope, which is its own entry. No Wikidata item found.

name: Church Street
note: The pedestrian street of antique stalls and galleries off Long Street.

name: Clock Tower
note: The Victorian port captain's tower at the Waterfront, beside the Robben Island ferry gateway.

name: Drakenstein Correctional Centre
note: The gate Nelson Mandela walked out of on 11 February 1990, with his statue before it.

name: Fairview
note: The Paarl estate visited for its goat's cheese as much as its wine. No Wikidata item found for the estate.

name: First Thursdays
note: Galleries and shops of the city centre open late on the first Thursday of the month. No Wikidata item found.

name: Franschhoek Motor Museum
note: On the L'Ormarins estate.

name: Helicopter flight over the peninsula
note: Flights leave from the Waterfront helipads.

name: Het Posthuys
note: The 1673 lookout post at Muizenberg, among the oldest buildings in the country. The only item of the name is a building on Vlieland in the Netherlands; none found for Muizenberg's.

name: Imhoff Farm
note: The farmyard of shops, cafés and animals at Kommetjie. No Wikidata item found.

name: Iziko Maritime Centre
note: The port's museum at the Waterfront.

name: Iziko Planetarium and Digital Dome
note: No Wikidata item found; it is part of the South African Museum's building.

name: Kalky's
note: The fish-and-chips shack on Kalk Bay harbour. No Wikidata item found.

name: Kirstenbosch Summer Sunset Concerts
note: Sunday-evening concerts on the lawn, November to April. No Wikidata item found.

name: Kitesurfing
note: At Bloubergstrand and Big Bay, and at Sunrise Beach, Muizenberg.

name: La Colombe
note: The fine-dining restaurant at Silvermist above Constantia Nek. No Wikidata item found.

name: La Motte
note: No Wikidata item found for the estate.

name: Labia Theatre
note: The independent cinema of 1949 on Orange Street.

name: Lookout Hill
note: The dune-top platform over Khayelitsha and the Cape Flats. No Wikidata item found for Khayelitsha's.

name: Maiden's Cove
note: The tidal pools and braai spot between Clifton and Camps Bay.

name: Nelson Mandela's cell
note: Cell 5 of B Section of the Maximum Security Prison, singled out on the tour. No item for the cell itself.

name: Marco's African Place
note: The African restaurant with live music in the Bo-Kaap. No Wikidata item found.

name: Mother City Queer Project
note: No Wikidata item found.

name: Newlands rugby and cricket grounds
note: The cricket ground is still played; the rugby stadium closed in 2021 and the Stormers play at Cape Town Stadium.

name: Noon Gun
note: Unsorted: the battery on Signal Hill whose gun has been fired at noon since 1806, and the firing itself, which visitors come for; the register has no kind for a daily ceremony or a battery.

name: Old Town House
note: The 1755 burgher watch house on Greenmarket Square, home of the Michaelis Collection of Dutch and Flemish paintings. The item is the building; same_as is the Michaelis Collection shown in it.

name: Oom Samie se Winkel
note: The Victorian general dealer on Dorp Street.

name: Oranjezicht City Farm Market
note: The Saturday and Sunday food market at Granger Bay. No Wikidata item found.

name: Tandem paragliding from Signal Hill or Lion's Head
Rhodes Cottage Museum
note: The cottage at Muizenberg where Cecil Rhodes died.

name: Rondevlei Nature Reserve
note: The wetland on the Cape Flats where Cape Town's hippos live.

name: A rugby match
note: The Stormers at Cape Town Stadium; Newlands until 2021.

name: Rustenberg
note: No Wikidata item found for the estate.

name: Scuba diving in False Bay
note: The kelp forests and shark dives of False Bay and the wrecks of the Atlantic side.

name: Sea Point Pavilion
note: The open-air sea-water pools on the Sea Point promenade.

name: Shark cage diving
note: From Simon's Town or, more often, from Gansbaai, 160 km east.

name: A drink in a township shebeen
Skeleton Gorge trail
note: The ascent of Table Mountain from Kirstenbosch.

name: Tandem skydive
note: From the drop zone at Melkbosstrand, north of the city.

name: Spring wildflowers of the West Coast
note: August and September, at the West Coast National Park, Darling and in Kirstenbosch.

name: St George's Cathedral
note: Desmond Tutu's cathedral, the 'People's Cathedral' of the anti-apartheid years.

name: Vin de Constance
note: Klein Constantia's revived dessert wine, the Constantia wine of Napoleon's exile. The item is Constantia, the historic dessert wine the name revives.

name: West Coast rock lobster
note: Eaten at Hout Bay and on the West Coast; in season from November. The item is the species, Jasus lalandii.
